shots.text: 1999. Site 12 was sealed... with people still inside.
Officially, it was only ever a weather station.
2015. Seven people are missing. Four are going in.

dialogue.text: There it is. The Blackwater Weather Station. Or what's left of it.
Sixteen years since they sealed this place. And seven people have walked in since August.
I remember the night they locked it down... Said it was a gas leak. They lied.
My mom and dad died in there. Now Marcus and Jenna are in there too. I'm not losing anyone else.
My source went in a month ago. If anyone's still alive, they're underground.
Then we'd better find a way in. Stay close. And keep your flashlights ready.
Something tells me we're not going to like what we find down there...

lore.text:
The notebook of the Journalist's missing informant.
One page is circled over and over:

"H-7"   "they're still down there"
lore.title: Informant's Notebook

lore.text:
BLACKWATER WEATHER STATION / SITE 12
Staff directory, revised 1998.

Dr. H. Calloway, Director, Project IRONWOOD
Dr. Maria Reyes, Medical
[NAME SCRATCHED OUT], Engineering, Growth Chamber design
C. Brennan, Security, Level B

All staff: volunteers are not to be told the true purpose of Serum H-7.
lore.title: Site 12 Staff Directory

lore.text:
A brass nameplate, worn smooth: CHIEF ENGINEER, GROWTH CHAMBER.
Next to it, a chipped coffee mug, still sitting where it was left decades ago.
lore.title: Desk Nameplate and Mug

lore.text:
A corkboard in the director's office, covered in newspaper clippings.
Every one of them is an article the Journalist wrote. Some are recent.
Red string connects her photo to the words: CONTAINED? ASK HER SOURCE.

Someone has been watching her.
lore.title: Corkboard: Newspaper Clippings

lore.text:
STRONGER SOLDIERS. SAFER NATION.

A smiling soldier salutes under bright red letters.
Someone has scratched the soldier's eyes out.
lore.title: Poster: Stronger Soldiers

lore.text:
Guard duty roster, Level B, the night of the sealing.
22:00 - 06:00: BRENNAN, C.

The signature at the bottom is Cole's.
lore.title: Guard Duty Roster

lore.text:
VOLUNTEER IDENTIFICATION, PROJECT BASTION
Volunteer No. 14
Name: DANIEL REYES
Status stamped in red: TRANSFERRED — PROJECT ECHO

The photo on the card shows a young man in uniform, smiling.
On the back, in faded ink: "For Eli."

Dad kept this with him until the end. In 1999, they said it was a gas leak. But the experiments never stopped. He was taken deeper. Into Project ECHO.
lore.title: Volunteer 14 ID Card

lore.text:
SUBJECT 7 - SERUM H-7 ("GROWTH")
Week 1: 6 ft 0 in. Good spirits. Asks about his mother.
Week 6: 6 ft 9 in. Joint pain. Bones still lengthening.
Week 14: 7 ft 11 in. Cannot lie flat. Light is painful to him.
Week 23: 9 ft 2 in. No longer fits in his cell.
Week 31: Moved to the maintenance tunnels. Stopped answering to his name.
lore.title: Medical Log: Subject 7

lore.text:
A child's crayon drawing taped inside a locker: two stick figures in uniforms, one in a lab coat, holding hands with a smaller stick figure between them.
Written at the bottom, in shaky child's handwriting: COME HOME SOON MOM AND DAD - LOVE ELI.
lore.title: Crayon Drawing

lore.text:
BY ORDER OF THE DIRECTOR - EMERGENCY CONTAINMENT, LEVEL B
All lower doors are to be sealed immediately, REGARDLESS OF PERSONNEL INSIDE.
Guard responsible: C. BRENNAN.

ELEVATOR OVERRIDE: two officers must turn their launch keys at the same time.
lore.title: Level B Containment Order

lore.text:
A blueprint pinned to the wall: GROWTH CHAMBER, MK II. Serum delivery and restraint system.
The signature in the corner is the Engineer's.
lore.title: Growth Chamber Blueprint

lore.text:
SPECIMEN LAB - PROGRAM ZERO
Tank 2: Volunteer 9. Rejected the serum. Kept for study.
Tank 4: Volunteer 11. Rejected the serum.
Tank 6: EMPTY. (Volunteer 14 - see Archive, cabinet 14.)

The elevator key is kept in the Archive. The Archive door code is shown on the lab monitor when the lab has power.
DO NOT open the Archive while Subject 7 is loose. He remembers the way.
lore.title: Specimen Lab Notes

lore.text:
To my boy,
They told us it was vitamins. They told us we were helping the country, that the Russians were doing worse. I believed them.
The big one in the tunnels... I knew him. We shared a bunk. He used to sing.
If they send me down to Level B, don't let them tell you I volunteered twice.
I'm coming home. I promise.

- Dad (Volunteer 14)

[The letter was never sent. He never came home. In 1999, they sealed the facility with him inside. The official story was a gas leak. But Mom knew the truth — she tried to get them out, and Walter killed her for it.]
lore.title: Unsent Letter, Cabinet 14

lore.text:
EMERGENCY POWER RESTART
1. Pour the fuel into the generator tank (a spare can is on the stairwell landing). The generator starts by itself.
2. Set the 3 main breakers to match the WIRING DIAGRAM on the wall beside them.
3. The security shutter to the lower tunnels opens when power is back.
lore.title: Power Room: Restart Procedure

lore.text:
DARKROOM - KEEP THE DOOR SHUT
No power, no safelight, no pictures.
The last roll from the pump room camera is still on the table. Somebody develop it. The pump room code was in that shot.
lore.title: Darkroom: Note on the Door

lore.text:
TUNNEL E FLOODED AGAIN.
The pumps only run with main power ON.
Drain procedure: open the 4 pump valves to the pattern on the chart.
The chart got moved into CELL 7 when they turned it into a store room. Nobody wants to go in there now.
lore.title: Maintenance: Flood Report

lore.text:
Tiny letters scratched into the metal, over and over:
HE CAN'T FOLD THIS SMALL. YOU'RE SAFE IN HERE.
KEEP CRAWLING. - 14
lore.title: Scratched Inside the Vent

lore.text:
INFIRMARY - PROGRAM ZERO VOLUNTEERS
Bed 1: joint pain, can't sleep. Says his bones are 'singing'.
Bed 2: nosebleeds stopped. Fever. Asking for his mother.
Bed 3: (empty - moved to Level B)
The gas masks are locked in the medicine cabinet: the Lab Wing corridor leaks again.
Cabinet code = the three bed tags, in order. Don't lose them this time.
lore.title: Infirmary Log

lore.text:
TO ALL STAFF - CONFIDENTIAL
If anyone asks, this is the Blackwater Weather Station. We measure rain. We measure wind.
We do NOT talk about the people who come in on the night bus, and we do NOT talk about the lower levels.
Anyone who forgets this will be transferred to Level B.
- The Director
lore.title: Memo: The Weather Station Story

lore.text:
An old photo taken at the Blackwater Weather Station. A woman in a lab coat stands beside a man in uniform, arms around a little boy with bright eyes. The woman is smiling. The man looks tired.
On the back, in pencil: MARIA & DANIEL & ELI - BLACKWATER STATION - 1998
lore.title: Photo: Family at Deepwell

lore.text:
CAMERA LOG - TUNNEL JUNCTION
02:14 - Volunteer 14 seen walking toward the cell. Talking to the door.
02:16 - Subject 7 answers him. (No audio. Both are smiling.)
02:31 - Guard Brennan escorts V14 back to the dormitory.
03:50 - Camera 4 knocked down from INSIDE the cell. Height of the hit: 11 ft.
lore.title: Security Camera Log

lore.text:
Third time this week the lights in the bypass went out with me in it.

Every time, the dripping stops. That's how you know. The water stops dripping because something tall is standing under the pipes and it's catching the drops.

If the dripping stops - get in the locker in the supply room and DON'T BREATHE.
lore.title: Written In Grease Pencil

lore.text:
MAINTENANCE NOTICE - MAIN TUNNEL, SECTION 3

The ceiling in Section 3 came down at 0340. No injuries. Probably.

Until it is cleared, ALL traffic goes through the maintenance bypass. Keep to the bypass and keep the lights on. The tubes in there have been failing for weeks and nobody wants to change them.

NOTE: The cave-in did not look like a cave-in. The supports were bent. From the inside.

- D. KESSLER, FACILITIES
lore.title: Notice: Main Tunnel Cave-In

lore.text:
SECURITY ARMORY - LEVEL B - SIGN-OUT

02:10  M1911 x2, .45 x4 mags ... Pvt. Hale
02:12  Shotgun, 12ga x1 box ... Pvt. Ortiz
02:31  ALL REMAINING SIDEARMS ... Sgt. ??? (signature smeared)
03:05  (no entry)
03:06  (no entry)

Scrawled across the bottom in red pen:
BULLETS SLOW IT DOWN. THEY DO NOT STOP IT. SHOOT AND MOVE.
lore.title: Armory Sign-Out Sheet

lore.text:
OBSERVATION BOOTH 2 - SUBJECT 7 (H-7)

WK 18: Subject stands in the corner facing the wall for 9 hrs. Does not sleep.
WK 20: Subject has learned the booth is staffed. Turns to face the glass when the booth door opens. We now keep the door shut.
WK 22: The booth door only stays open while someone stands on the plate outside. Two-man rule. Nobody goes in alone.
WK 24: Vault code is on the booth monitor ONLY. Read it, call it out, get out.
WK 25: Subject tapped on the glass. Four times. Then the code changed.
lore.title: Observation Log - Subject 7

lore.text:
SPECIMEN VAULT - CONTENTS

H-7 SERUM, BATCH 1-6 .......... DESTROYED
H-7 SERUM, BATCH 7 ............ 3 VIALS (see Dr. Reyes)
BONE SAMPLES, SUBJ. 7 ......... 41 jars. Still growing in the jar.
PROGRAM ZERO - TRANSFER FILES .. MOVED TO LEVEL D

A note paper-clipped to the page:
The samples grow even in formaldehyde. Whatever H-7 is, it isn't finished with him. It isn't finished with any of them.
lore.title: Specimen Vault Manifest

lore.text:
A laminated press badge, cracked down the middle: DANIEL MARSH - THE BLACKWATER COURIER.
Her informant. The man who stopped answering her calls.
On the back, in his handwriting:
They keep the proof in the vault. If I don't come out, the code is in the booth. Don't go in alone.
lore.title: Press Badge - D. Marsh

lore.text:
LEVEL B COMMUNICATIONS - DUTY LOG

The elevator override has to be AUTHORISED by the surface relay. No relay, no override. That was the whole point: nobody comes up unless the surface says so.

The relay listens on the emergency band. The band DRIFTS (cheap crystals). Somebody reads the live frequency off the antenna room chart and calls it out; somebody else tunes.

Last entry, 03:12: Surface is not answering. Surface is LISTENING. I can hear them breathing on the line.
lore.title: Comms Room Duty Log

lore.text:
A carbon copy of a radio transcript, folded small and tucked behind the antenna chart.

B-COMMS: Surface, this is Level B. Request elevator override. We have people down here.
SURFACE: Negative, Level B. Containment order stands.
B-COMMS: Who signed it? WHO SIGNED IT?
SURFACE: ...Sergeant C. Brennan has the order.

Someone has circled the name, again and again, until the pen went through the paper.
lore.title: Transcript - Last Call to the Surface

lore.text:
A brass maker's plate riveted to the second boiler:
PRESSURE VESSEL B-2 - DESIGNED FOR PROJECT IRONWOOD
CHIEF DESIGN ENGINEER: (the name has been filed off, but the Engineer knows whose it was)

The boilers didn't heat the building. They heated the growth chamber.
lore.title: Boiler Maker's Plate

lore.text:
BOILER ROOM - PRESSURE LOG

VENTING THE BOILERS NEEDS BOTH RELIEF VALVES OPEN AT THE SAME TIME: one here by the boilers, one in the gauge room. One valve on its own does nothing but scream.

The pressure cage stays locked while the boilers are hot. Spare supplies are in the cage.

Personal note: the boilers knock all night. Kessler says it's the pipes. The pipes don't knock in rhythm. Four knocks. Wait. Four knocks.
lore.title: Boiler Room Pressure Log

lore.text:
LEVEL B MORGUE - INTAKE

Drawer 1 ... Volunteer 3 ... 'cardiac' ... (bones measured 2x normal density)
Drawer 2 ... Volunteer 9 ... 'cardiac'
Drawer 3 ... Volunteer 11 ... 'cardiac' ... (spine had grown THROUGH the skull)
Drawer 4 ... EMPTY. Body was here at 22:00. Gone at 06:00. Drawer was opened from the INSIDE.

Note to staff: cold room code is split across the toe tags, so nobody gets in alone. Collect all four.
lore.title: Morgue Intake Ledger

lore.text:
A plastic intake bracelet, the kind they use at processing, but adult-sized:
VOLUNTEER 14 — PROJECT BASTION — DO NOT AUTOPSY — TRANSFER TO LEVEL D

Do not autopsy. Because they weren't dead.
lore.title: Intake Bracelet - Volunteer 14

lore.text:
WEST DORM - LEVEL B
Eight bunks. Twelve men on rotation. Nobody has slept here in sixteen years.

MAINTENANCE NOTE: The dorm runs on its own AUX breaker bank. Whenever the main grid is reset the aux bank trips. The new switch sequence is pinned up on the bunk-room wall. If the dorm is dark, the elevator consoles will NOT accept an override.

- D. KESSLER, FACILITIES
lore.title: Billeting Log - West Dorm

lore.text:
IT WATCHES YOU SLEEP.

It doesn't come in the rooms. It stands in the doorway with its head against the frame and it WAITS. We stopped sleeping in shifts and started sleeping in the vent.

If you're reading this and the lights are out - the aux breakers are in the back room. Set them to the card and RUN.
lore.title: Scrawled On The Bunk Frame

lore.text:
A sheriff's poster, stapled over older ones. Seven faces.

MISSING NEAR THE BLACKWATER WEATHER STATION

Daniel Marsh, 41 - reporter
Ruth Alvarez, 58 - hiker
Tomas Greer, 33 - surveyor
Kelly Ann Doss, 19 - student
Owen Pratt, 27 - trucker
Marcus Bell, 21 - student
Jenna Park, 20 - student

Last seen: the access road, between August and October 2015.
If you have information, call the Sheriff's Office.

Someone has written across the bottom in marker: THEY WENT IN. NOBODY CAME OUT.
lore.title: MISSING - Have You Seen Them?

lore.text:
A small video camera, the red light still blinking. Marcus's sticker is on the side.

The last clip:
JENNA: Okay, okay, we're in. Eli is going to be SO mad we came without him.
MARCUS: He'd never come. You know what happened to his parents in here.
JENNA: That's why we're doing it. For him. ...Did you hear that?
MARCUS: Hear what?
(Something very tall walks past the end of the stairs. The clip ends.)
lore.title: Marcus and Jenna's Camera

lore_book.text:
A crude height chart painted on the tunnel wall, marks climbing week by week.
The numbers go: 6'0" ... 7'11" ... 9'2" ... and then the marks continue past the ceiling.

Someone wrote beside the highest mark:
HE DOESN'T FIT ANYMORE.
lore_book.title: Height Chart

lore_book.text:
Hundreds of tally marks scratched into the concrete wall of the stairwell.
They go on for floors. Someone was counting the days.

Near the bottom, in a different hand:
THEY'RE STILL ALIVE IN THERE.
lore_book.title: Tally Marks

FROM: THE DIRECTOR
Phase One gave us Subject 7. He is strong, but he cannot be controlled, and he will not stop growing.
Phase Two volunteers will be kept in the dormitory until we know what the serum does to the others.
If containment fails: seal the blast door, and get the staff out by the escape lift. ONLY the staff.

MAINTENANCE NOTE: The dorm runs on its own AUX breaker bank. Whenever the main grid is reset the aux bank trips. The new switch sequence is pinned up on the bunk-room wall. If the dorm is dark, the elevator consoles will NOT accept an override.

- D. KESSLER, FACILITIES
lore_book.title: Billeting Log - West Dorm

lore_book.text:
TUNNEL E FLOODED AGAIN.
The pumps only run with main power ON.
Drain procedure: open the 4 pump valves to the pattern on the chart.
The chart got moved into CELL 7 when they turned it into a store room. Nobody wants to go in there now.
lore_book.title: Maintenance: Flood Report

lore_book.text:
INFIRMARY - PROGRAM ZERO VOLUNTEERS
Bed 1: joint pain, can't sleep. Says his bones are 'singing'.
Bed 2: nosebleeds stopped. Fever. Asking for his mother.
Bed 3: (empty - moved to Level B)
The gas masks are locked in the medicine cabinet: the Lab Wing corridor leaks again.
Cabinet code = the three bed tags, in order. Don't lose them this time.
lore_book.title: Infirmary Log

lore_book.text:
LEVEL B - INTAKE LOG, PROGRAM ZERO
Volunteers moved down for 'Phase Two': 9, 11, 12, 14.
No. 14 asked twice for a letter to be posted to his son. Request denied.
No. 12 tried to climb the elevator cables. Recovered.
Staff reminder: Level B residents are NOT to be told about Subject 7.
lore_book.title: Level B Intake Log

lore_book.text:
A sheriff's poster, stapled over older ones. Seven faces.

MISSING NEAR THE BLACKWATER WEATHER STATION

Daniel Marsh, 41 - reporter
Ruth Alvarez, 58 - hiker
Tomas Greer, 33 - surveyor
Kelly Ann Doss, 19 - student
Owen Pratt, 27 - trucker
Marcus Bell, 21 - student
Jenna Park, 20 - student

Last seen: the access road, between August and October 2015.
If you have information, call the Sheriff's Office.

Someone has written across the bottom in marker: THEY WENT IN. NOBODY CAME OUT.
lore_book.title: MISSING - Have You Seen Them?

lore_book.text:
LEVEL B MORGUE - INTAKE

Drawer 1 ... Volunteer 3 ... 'cardiac' ... (bones measured 2x normal density)
Drawer 2 ... Volunteer 9 ... 'cardiac'
Drawer 3 ... Volunteer 11 ... 'cardiac' ... (spine had grown THROUGH the skull)
Drawer 4 ... EMPTY. Body was here at 22:00. Gone at 06:00. Drawer was opened from the INSIDE.

Note to staff: cold room code is split across the toe tags, so nobody gets in alone. Collect all four.
lore_book.title: Morgue Intake Ledger

lore_book.text:
OBSERVATION BOOTH 2 - SUBJECT 7 (H-7)

WK 18: Subject stands in the corner facing the wall for 9 hrs. Does not sleep.
WK 20: Subject has learned the booth is staffed. Turns to face the glass when the booth door opens. We now keep the door shut.
WK 22: The booth door only stays open while someone stands on the plate outside. Two-man rule. Nobody goes in alone.
WK 24: Vault code is on the booth monitor ONLY. Read it, call it out, get out.
WK 25: Subject tapped on the glass. Four times. Then the code changed.
lore_book.title: Observation Log - Subject 7

lore_book.text:
STRONGER SOLDIERS. SAFER NATION.

A smiling soldier salutes under bright red letters.
Someone has scratched the soldier's eyes out.
lore_book.title: Poster: Stronger Soldiers

lore_book.text:
EMERGENCY POWER RESTART
1. Pour the fuel into the generator tank (a spare can is on the stairwell landing). The generator starts by itself.
2. Set the 3 main breakers to match the WIRING DIAGRAM on the wall beside them.
3. The security shutter to the lower tunnels opens when power is back.
lore_book.title: Power Room: Restart Procedure

lore_book.text:
EMERGENCY BROADCAST - LEVEL B
The dormitory door code is broadcast on a loop on the emergency frequency, in case the staff lose their badges.
The frequency is posted on the chart in the signal booth. It DRIFTS. Read it out while someone tunes.
If you can hear this, you are already too far down.
lore_book.title: Radio Room Log

lore_book.text:
CAMERA LOG - TUNNEL JUNCTION
02:14 - Volunteer 14 seen walking toward the cell. Talking to the door.
02:16 - Subject 7 answers him. (No audio. Both are smiling.)
02:31 - Guard Brennan escorts V14 back to the dormitory.
03:50 - Camera 4 knocked down from INSIDE the cell. Height of the hit: 11 ft.
lore_book.title: Security Camera Log

lore_book.text:
SPECIMEN LAB - PROGRAM ZERO
Tank 2: Volunteer 9. Rejected the serum. Kept for study.
Tank 4: Volunteer 11. Rejected the serum.
Tank 6: EMPTY. (Volunteer 14 - see Archive, cabinet 14.)

The elevator key is kept in the Archive. The Archive door code is shown on the lab monitor when the lab has power.
DO NOT open the Archive while Subject 7 is loose. He remembers the way.
lore_book.title: Specimen Lab Notes

lore_book.text:
BLACKWATER WEATHER STATION / SITE 12
Staff directory, revised 1998.

Dr. H. Calloway, Director, Project IRONWOOD
Dr. Maria Reyes, Medical
[NAME SCRATCHED OUT], Engineering, Growth Chamber design
C. Brennan, Security, Level B

All staff: volunteers are not to be told the true purpose of Serum H-7.
lore_book.title: Site 12 Staff Directory

lore_book.text:
SUBJECT 7 - SERUM H-7 ("GROWTH")
Week 1: 6 ft 0 in. Good spirits. Asks about his mother.
Week 6: 6 ft 9 in. Joint pain. Bones still lengthening.
Week 14: 7 ft 11 in. Cannot lie flat. Light is painful to him.
Week 23: 9 ft 2 in. No longer fits in his cell.
Week 31: Moved to the maintenance tunnels. Stopped answering to his name.
lore_book.title: Medical Log: Subject 7

lore_book.text:
SPECIMEN VAULT - CONTENTS

H-7 SERUM, BATCH 1-6 .......... DESTROYED
H-7 SERUM, BATCH 7 ............ 3 VIALS (see Dr. Reyes)
BONE SAMPLES, SUBJ. 7 ......... 41 jars. Still growing in the jar.
PROGRAM ZERO - TRANSFER FILES .. MOVED TO LEVEL D

A note paper-clipped to the page:
The samples grow even in formaldehyde. Whatever H-7 is, it isn't finished with him. It isn't finished with any of them.
lore_book.title: Specimen Vault Manifest

lore_book.text:
TO ALL STAFF - CONFIDENTIAL
If anyone asks, this is the Blackwater Weather Station. We measure rain. We measure wind.
We do NOT talk about the people who come in on the night bus, and we do NOT talk about the lower levels.
Anyone who forgets this will be transferred to Level B.
- The Director
lore_book.title: Memo: The Weather Station Story

lore_book.text:
IT WATCHES YOU SLEEP.

It doesn't come in the rooms. It stands in the doorway with its head against the frame and it WAITS. We stopped sleeping in shifts and started sleeping in the vent.

If you're reading this and the lights are out - the aux breakers are in the back room. Set them to the card and RUN.
lore_book.title: Scrawled On The Bunk Frame

lore_book.text:
A blueprint pinned to the wall: GROWTH CHAMBER, MK II. Serum delivery and restraint system.
The signature in the corner is the Engineer's.
lore_book.title: Growth Chamber Blueprint

lore_book.text:
A brass maker's plate riveted to the second boiler:
PRESSURE VESSEL B-2 - DESIGNED FOR PROJECT IRONWOOD
CHIEF DESIGN ENGINEER: (the name has been filed off, but the Engineer knows whose it was)

The boilers didn't heat the building. They heated the growth chamber.
lore_book.title: Boiler Maker's Plate

lore_book.text:
A brass nameplate, worn smooth: CHIEF ENGINEER, GROWTH CHAMBER.
Next to it, a chipped coffee mug, still sitting where it was left decades ago.
lore_book.title: Desk Nameplate and Mug

lore_book.text:
A carbon copy of a radio transcript, folded small and tucked behind the antenna chart.

B-COMMS: Surface, this is Level B. Request elevator override. We have people down here.
SURFACE: Negative, Level B. Containment order stands.
B-COMMS: Who signed it? WHO SIGNED IT?
SURFACE: ...Sergeant C. Brennan has the order.

Someone has circled the name, again and again, until the pen went through the paper.
lore_book.title: Transcript - Last Call to the Surface

lore_book.text:
C. BRENNAN - GUARD LOG, LEVEL B
Night 1: They put the volunteers in the dormitory. Kids, most of them.
Night 9: The big one walks the halls at night. They call it Subject 7. I call it Tommy. It was Tommy.
Night 12: The order came to seal the doors. I sealed them.
I hid in a locker and listened to him look for me. He walked right past. He knows the lockers now.
God forgive me.
lore_book.title: Guard's Logbook (C. Brennan)

lore_book.text:
Guard duty roster, Level B, the night of the sealing.
22:00 - 06:00: BRENNAN, C.

The signature at the bottom is Cole's.
lore_book.title: Guard Duty Roster

lore_book.text:
A laminated press badge, cracked down the middle: DANIEL MARSH - THE BLACKWATER COURIER.
Her informant. The man who stopped answering her calls.
On the back, in his handwriting:
They keep the proof in the vault. If I don't come out, the code is in the booth. Don't go in alone.
lore_book.title: Press Badge - D. Marsh

lore_book.text:
The notebook of the Journalist's missing informant.
One page is circled over and over:

"H-7"   "they're still down there"
lore_book.title: Informant's Notebook

lore_book.text:
A plastic intake bracelet, the kind they use at processing, but adult-sized:
VOLUNTEER 14 — PROJECT BASTION — DO NOT AUTOPSY — TRANSFER TO LEVEL D

Do not autopsy. Because they weren't dead.
lore_book.title: Intake Bracelet - Volunteer 14

lore_book.text:
A dog tag hanging from the frame of bunk 14. The name is scratched off, but the number isn't: 14.
Scratched into the wall above the bunk, in tiny letters:
ELI - I'M SORRY I'M LATE. I'M STILL COMING HOME.
lore_book.title: Dog Tag, Bunk 14

lore_book.text:
A child's crayon drawing taped inside a locker: two stick figures in uniforms, one in a lab coat, holding hands with a smaller stick figure between them.
Written at the bottom, in shaky child's handwriting: COME HOME SOON MOM AND DAD - LOVE ELI.
lore_book.title: Crayon Drawing

lore_book.text:
To my boy,
They told us it was vitamins. They told us we were helping the country, that the Russians were doing worse. I believed them.
The big one in the tunnels... I knew him. We shared a bunk. He used to sing.
If they send me down to Level B, don't let them tell you I volunteered twice.
I'm coming home. I promise.

- Dad (Volunteer 14)

[The letter was never sent. He never came home. In 1999, they sealed the facility with him inside. The official story was a gas leak. But Mom knew the truth — she tried to get them out, and Walter killed her for it.]
lore_book.title: Unsent Letter, Cabinet 14

lore_book.text:
A small video camera, the red light still blinking. Marcus's sticker is on the side.

The last clip:
JENNA: Okay, okay, we're in. Eli is going to be SO mad we came without him.
MARCUS: He'd never come. You know what happened to his parents in here.
JENNA: That's why we're doing it. For him. ...Did you hear that?
MARCUS: Hear what?
(Something very tall walks past the end of the stairs. The clip ends.)
lore_book.title: Marcus and Jenna's Camera

lore_book.text:
An old photo taken at the Blackwater Weather Station. A woman in a lab coat stands beside a man in uniform, arms around a little boy with bright eyes. The woman is smiling. The man looks tired.
On the back, in pencil: MARIA & DANIEL & ELI - BLACKWATER STATION - 1998
lore_book.title: Photo: Family at Deepwell

lore_book.text:
Tiny letters scratched into the metal, over and over:
HE CAN'T FOLD THIS SMALL. YOU'RE SAFE IN HERE.
KEEP CRAWLING. - 14
lore_book.title: Scratched Inside the Vent

lore_book.text:
VOLUNTEER IDENTIFICATION, PROJECT BASTION
Volunteer No. 14
Name: DANIEL REYES
Status stamped in red: TRANSFERRED — PROJECT ECHO

The photo on the card shows a young man in uniform, smiling.
On the back, in faded ink: "For Eli."

Dad kept this with him until the end. In 1999, they said it was a gas leak. But the experiments never stopped. He was taken deeper. Into Project ECHO.
lore_book.title: Volunteer 14 ID Card

lore_book.text:
Long drag marks in the dirt, leading from the road to the station gate.
They're fresh. Something still moves around here.
lore_book.title: Photo: Fresh Drag Marks

lore_book.text:
A blurred flash photo of something impossibly tall folding itself through the tunnel.
Proof. This is what H-7 did. This is what her informant died trying to show the world.
lore_book.title: Photo: Subject 7

lore_book.text:
A photo of deep scratch marks on the wall, more than two and a half meters off the floor.
Whatever made them was very, very tall.
lore_book.title: Photo: Scratch Marks

lore_book.text:
DR. REYES: This is Dr. Maria Reyes, Medical. If anyone finds this...
DR. REYES: The alarms started twenty minutes ago. Level B is sealing.
DR. REYES: Subject 7 is out of his cell. He doesn't fit through the doors anymore, so he... folds.
DR. REYES: The guard on duty has the order. He's closing the doors with people still inside.
DR. REYES: God forgive us. It was never vitamins.
DR. REYES: Danny went down to Level B to get the others out. He hasn't come back.
DR. REYES: Someone locked Medical from the outside. I heard the key. Only engineering has those keys.
DR. REYES: Eli, baby, if this ever reaches you... Mommy and Daddy love you. Don't ever come here.
(Something heavy scrapes along the ceiling. The tape ends.)
lore_book.title: Reel Tape 2: Final Recording

lore_book.text:
BRENNAN: This is Cole Brennan. If you're hearing this, you got further than most.
BRENNAN: He hates light. A flash in the face makes him stop and scream. Use it.
BRENNAN: He hears radios. He hears doors. He hears you RUN.
BRENNAN: And if he sees you hide... he remembers where.
BRENNAN: I'm sorry. I sealed the doors. I'm going down to find the ones I left behind.
(Static. A long, low breath that isn't Cole's.)
lore_book.title: Reel Tape: Brennan's Warning

lore_book.text:
TECH: Relay test, Level B to surface. Testing, testing.
SURFACE: Read you, Level B. Loud and clear.
TECH: Copy. Frequency's drifting again. I'll call it out, you match it.
SURFACE: Hang on. Level B, who else is on this line?
TECH: Nobody. Just me.
SURFACE: Then who's breathing?
(Four slow taps on the microphone. The tape ends.)
lore_book.title: Reel Tape: Relay Test

lore_book.text:
SGT. VOSS: Booth two, this is Voss. You reading the code?
PVT. HALE: Reading it now. Three... wait. Something's on the glass.
SGT. VOSS: Stay on the plate, Ortiz. Do NOT step off that plate.
PVT. ORTIZ: I'm on it! I'm on it! Hale, get out of there!
PVT. HALE: The door - the door's closing - ORTIZ!
(A long scraping sound. The plate clicks. The tape runs on in silence.)
lore_book.title: Reel Tape: The Two-Man Rule

lore_book.text:
DIRECTOR CALLOWAY: Good morning, volunteers, and welcome to Site 12.
DIRECTOR CALLOWAY: What you do here will make this nation stronger than any other.
DIRECTOR CALLOWAY: You will receive a simple course of vitamins. Nothing more.
DIRECTOR CALLOWAY: Report any... changes to the medical staff at once.
DIRECTOR CALLOWAY: Remember your volunteer number. You will need it at the lower doors.
(The tape clicks. Someone breathes very close to the microphone.)
lore_book.title: Reel Tape 1: Welcome, Volunteers

triggers.message: It's cold down here. Something smells like rust and old blood.
The elevator. The only way down.
Rows and rows of files. Something is breathing between the shelves.
Something moves between the trees behind the shed. It's gone when you look.
Something is pounding on the other side of the vent wall... but it can't get in.
It smells like old medicine. One of the curtains is moving... no wind in here.
The lights die. Something is breathing in the dark...
Something taps on the glass. Four times.
The radio in the other room crackles... and someone whispers your names.
Four knocks inside the boiler. Then four more.
Somewhere behind you, a drawer slides open by itself.
Slow footsteps cross the dorm... but you are the only one down here.
